sonnet.problem: Verse 14 is a law given as a case: 'if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off… he has broken My covenant.' The card turns it into a flat statement ('A male who isn't circumcised has broken God's covenant') and drops the 'if' framing.
sonnet.rule: **Cases stay cases.** A law given as a case stays a case: "If someone…, God says…"
